payload.reason: The evidence provides specific measures taken to ensure that paths were not shared between the training and test sets, including filtering queries and excluding hyponyms from the test and validation sets that appeared in the training set.

claims.text: Queries observed during path training were eliminated to ensure all evaluated queries were new to both path-based and non-path models.
Hyponyms appearing in the training set were excluded from the test and validation sets to prevent models from copying.
None of the queries (synsets) are shared between the training and evaluation sets, although some lemma-level overlaps exist.
